title: Outcomes and User Acceptance of the IntelliVue Alarm Advisor Software (USA)
brief_summary: This Clinical Study will be conducted as a comparative study focusing on usability and efficiency by comparing alarm burden pre- and post- implementation of an "Alarm Advisor software".
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Patients admitted to the intensive care units during the study periods

Exclusion Criteria:

\- none
